name: Usaha pada bangunan induk tempat tinggal
description: Usaha pada bangunan induk tempat tinggal; unit roster Ditemukan/Baru yang selesai/disetujui, tanpa syarat skala/prelist.
denominator_definition: COUNT record eligible (konteks hitungan; bukan rate)
eligibility_rule: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mart_keluarga f WHERE f.assignment_id=u.assignment_id AND f.__version_normalized=u.__version_normalized AND f.kode_penggunaan_bangunan='3')
null_skip_rule: NULL/kosong tidak diisi nol; skip/ketiadaan rincian tidak disimpulkan sebagai jawaban tidak. Tidak mengubah sumber.
interpretation_limits: Klasifikasi bangunan induk keluarga berdasarkan r.kode_bang_value 2/3 pada versi tepat. Bukan bukti lokasi fisik kegiatan setiap usaha: roster juga mencakup keliling, kegiatan luar rumah, pertanian. Skala kosong dan jenis_usaha kosong tidak diisi; bukan total unik fisik. Keaktifan hanya diketahui dari filter historis ekspor.
sql_formula: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_rows,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN 1=1 AND 1=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS numerator,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS denominator FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT u."__row_id",u."__import_id",u."__clean_hash",u."__key",u."__version_normalized",u."__key_valid",u."__conflict",u."assignment_id",u."assignment_date_modified",u."index1",u."code_identity",u."is_prelist2",u."kecamatan",u."desa_kelurahan",u."kode_sls_subsls",u."sls_subsls",u."nomor_bangunan",u."nomor_usaha",u."nama_usaha",u."nama_komersial",u."kode_keberadaan_usaha",u."keberadaan_usaha",u."alamat_usaha",u."jenis_usaha",u."nama_pengusaha_pj",u."kegiatan_utama",u."produk_utama",u."kbli",u."kategori",u."skala_usaha",u."geotag_latitude",u."geotag_longitude",u."__batch_id",u."__source_sha256" FROM (SELECT u."__row_id",u."__import_id",u."__clean_hash",u."__key",u."__version_normalized",u."__key_valid",u."__conflict",u."assignment_id",u."assignment_date_modified",u."index1",u."code_identity",u."is_prelist2",u."kecamatan",u."desa_kelurahan",u."kode_sls_subsls",u."sls_subsls",u."nomor_bangunan",u."nomor_usaha",u."nama_usaha",u."nama_komersial",u."kode_keberadaan_usaha",u."keberadaan_usaha",u."alamat_usaha",u."jenis_usaha",u."nama_pengusaha_pj",u."kegiatan_utama",u."produk_utama",u."kbli",u."kategori",u."skala_usaha",u."geotag_latitude",u."geotag_longitude",u."__batch_id",u."__source_sha256" FROM (SELECT u."__row_id",u."__import_id",u."__clean_hash",u."__key",u."__version_normalized",u."__key_valid",u."__conflict",u."assignment_id",u."assignment_date_modified",u."index1",u."code_identity",u."is_prelist2",u."kecamatan",u."desa_kelurahan",u."kode_sls_subsls",u."sls_subsls",u."nomor_bangunan",u."nomor_usaha",u."nama_usaha",u."nama_komersial",u."kode_keberadaan_usaha",u."keberadaan_usaha",u."alamat_usaha",u."jenis_usaha",u."nama_pengusaha_pj",u."kegiatan_utama",u."produk_utama",u."kbli",u."kategori",u."skala_usaha",u."geotag_latitude",u."geotag_longitude",u."__batch_id",u."__source_sha256" FROM mart_usaha u WHERE u.kode_keberadaan_usaha IN ('1','2') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mart_assignment_tgr a WHERE a.assignment_id=u.assignment_id AND a.status_assignment IN ('APPROVED BY Pengawas','COMPLETED BY Admin Kabupaten'))) u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mart_keluarga f WHERE f.assignment_id=u.assignment_id AND f.__version_normalized=u.__version_normalized) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mart_bku b WHERE b.assignment_id=u.assignment_id AND b.__version_normalized=u.__version_normalized AND b.kode_penggunaan_bangunan='1')) u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mart_keluarga f WHERE f.assignment_id=u.assignment_id AND f.__version_normalized=u.__version_normalized AND f.kode_penggunaan_bangunan='3')) LIMIT -1 OFFSET 0) e WHERE 1=1
